messages:
Alice M: Quick heads up — Azure marketplace asked for SOC2 + external pen-test evidence to finalize the HW+SI listing. We need clear owners for each artifact and presign flow. Who can take SOC2?
BenK: I can own SOC2 artifacts. I’ll collect the report, AICPA scope doc, and produce a redacted bundle.
Carla S: I’ll own pen-test coordination with SI and the HW vendor. Need timeline from the pentest provider and who will handle redaction.
Elena (HW-SI): Vendor confirmed external pentest week of Apr 15. We’ll need presigned S3 links + a redaction checklist for any findings containing customer data.
Dave R: @PartnerOpsBot create a bucket path and presign template for partner uploads. TTL = 48h unless we override. Example presign step:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/partners/si-123/report.pdf --expires-in 172800
```
PartnerOpsBot: Created bucket: marketplace-evidence/partners/si-123. Default presign TTL set to 48h. Example link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/marketplace-evidence/partners/si-123/report.pdf?X-Amz-... (redacted).
BenK: Also — need to mark which docs are PII-sensitive so redaction owner is clear. Suggest redaction owner = Carla S and BenK will provide SOC2 redaction guidelines.
Carla S: Agree. I’ll draft a redaction checklist and a tiny helper script for common patterns (emails, IPs). Snippet:```python
# redact helper (toy)
import re
def redact(text):
    text = re.sub(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+","[REDACTED_EMAIL]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b","[REDACTED_IP]", text)
    return text
```
Alice M: We also need to coordinate marketing/legal for the joint announcement. @Elena, can SI legal sign off on copy if we share the redacted SOC2 + pen attestation?
Elena (HW-SI): SI legal requires redacted SOC2 and the pentest attestation before sign-off. BenK — can you share redacted SOC2 by Apr 12?
BenK: Yes — target Apr 12 for redacted SOC2 bundle.
Dave R: Operational note: if pentest report isn’t in by Apr 20 we’ll publish listing with a marketplace-compliant "pending-pen-test" flag and update later. We should be explicit in the listing metadata about outstanding items.
Carla S: Timeline summary I’ll track: pen-test report due Apr 18, redaction completed by Apr 17, presign links live Apr 13–Apr 19 window. I’ll add owners to the runbook.
Alice M: Action items: BenK (SOC2 redaction by Apr 12), Carla S (pen-test triage + redaction checklist), Dave R (bucket + presign TTL + fallback flag), Elena (SI legal signoff once redacted artifacts shared). Quick sync Friday 10:00 to confirm.
PartnerOpsBot: Reminder scheduled — "Marketplace compliance sync" Fri 10:00. If anything changes, reply here and I’ll update attendees/links.
